description: Scrape posts, comments, topic feeds, and company-specific feeds from TeamBlind. A logged-in cookie is REQUIRED — TeamBlind is login-walled.

autoEscalateOnBlock.description: If true (default), the actor engages Apify residential proxy on HTTP 403 / 429 blocks.
autoEscalateOnBlock.title: Auto-escalate to Apify residential proxy on block

companies.description: Company slugs as they appear in TeamBlind URLs (e.g. `Google`, `Amazon`, `Meta`, `Microsoft`, `Apple`, `Netflix`, `Salesforce`, `Uber`, `Airbnb`, `Stripe`).
companies.title: Companies (mode=byCompany)

cookieHeader.description: Optional for list modes (searchPosts, byTopic, byCompany) — those work without login. Required for byPost (full thread + comments). To get: open teamblind.com while signed in, DevTools → Network → any request → copy the full `Cookie` header value. Look for `b_session_id=...`. The actor sends this verbatim.
cookieHeader.sectionDescription: List modes (searchPosts, byTopic, byCompany) work without a cookie. byPost requires a logged-in cookie to retrieve the full thread body.
cookieHeader.title: TeamBlind cookie header (required for byPost mode)

country.description: TeamBlind region. `us` and `in` both use www.teamblind.com (TeamBlind serves India-region feeds via the same host based on user account country). `kr` swaps to kr.teamblind.com.
country.title: Country / locale

includeComments.description: Emit each comment as a separate record alongside the post body.
includeComments.title: Include comments (mode=byPost)

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted records (post + comment + error records combined).
maxItems.sectionDescription: Output cap and anti-bot escalation behaviour.
maxItems.title: Max items

enumTitles: By post (single thread URL → full content + comments)
mode.sectionDescription: Pick what to scrape from TeamBlind. Other inputs adapt to the selected mode.
mode.title: Mode

postUrls.description: Full TeamBlind post URLs (e.g. `https://www.teamblind.com/post/...`). For mode=byUrl you can also paste topic / company / search URLs.
postUrls.title: Post URLs (mode=byPost / byUrl)

proxyGroups.description: Apify proxy groups to engage on auto-escalation. Empty = datacenter (default), then residential fallback.
proxyGroups.title: Apify proxy groups (used on auto-escalation)

query.description: Free-text search query. TeamBlind's search returns matched posts ranked by relevance.
query.sectionDescription: Provide a query, topic, companies, or URLs depending on the mode you picked above.
query.title: Search query (mode=searchPosts)

sortBy.description: Sort feed by recency (default) or popularity.
sortBy.title: Sort order (mode=byTopic / byCompany)

topic.description: TeamBlind topic / channel. The most popular feeds are listed here; if you need a less-common one use mode=byUrl.
topic.title: Topic (mode=byTopic)

title: TeamBlind Scraper Input
